relay.transcript.bridge.held.note: A temporary hold awaiting review, not a refusal or pending delivery.

relay.transcript.bridge.offline.note: Reports a connection failure and ongoing retry without asking the reader to act.

relay.transcript.bridge.thread_reply.note: Identifies a reply inside a thread rather than a top-level post.

relay.transcript.jump.latest.note: Direct navigation to the newest message, without a hand-inserted arrow.

relay.transcript.jump.latest_short.note: Natural shortening of the full label.

checks.key_and_placeholder_parity: 43/43 exact key set, no duplicates; ICU argument names, types, select arms, braces and # preserved after projecting English plurals to zh-CN other-only.
checks.semantics: Read every value against English, context, i18n/glossary.md and i18n/style-guides/zh-CN.md. The untrusted label describes provenance and trust, not moderation. Awaiting screening and awaiting delivery do not imply moderation acted; actual refusal explicitly does.
checks.target_delta_coverage: Compared raw JSON value tokens against origin/main: exactly held, offline and thread_reply differ (thread_reply is new); all 40 other value tokens, including both jump keys, are byte-identical despite file indentation changes.
checks.text_integrity: All 43 target strings are NFC; no Unicode format/control characters, manual direction markers, or escaped entities found.

scope_note: This independent merged-namespace audit binds the listed source and target hashes. Unchanged keys are byte-identical at the value-token level to origin/main and retain prior audits, including the jump keys; this does not grant them new approvals. No native-speaker claim, rendered-fit review, or locale activation approval.
filing_note: The evidence tool is unavailable in this build; filed this one receipt via the manager-authorized single cat fallback.
